selection.reason: The request is to answer open tickets that match common questions (shipping and password) with the user's own reply text, and send every other ticket to a person in one digest, which is exactly what this template does.
notCovered: Sending the digest to help@cobaltcandle.com is assumed to be the digest recipient; confirm that the template's digest address can be set to this address.
The shipping reply promises a tracking link by email; the template sends only the reply text the user wrote, so the link must be included in that text or sent separately.

workflow.title: Support ticket answers and escalation
workflow.goal: Each run, answer the open, non-urgent tickets that mention a known keyword with the person's reply for it, and send every other open ticket to help@cobaltcandle.com in one digest, after a person approves each e-mail.

assumptions: The tickets sheet holds one row per ticket with id, from, subject, body, priority and status
Delivery is a local outbox file standing in for e-mail; nothing leaves this machine
risks: An urgent or unusual ticket answered by a canned reply
successCriteria: Every open ticket was either answered with a matching reply or sent to the person
No urgent ticket was answered automatically
This run delivered exactly the planned e-mails, each intact (checked by re-reading the outbox)
unsupported: Running on a schedule by itself

nodes.description: Decide for each ticket: a known answer, or a person (urgent tickets always go to a person)

The support team
